title: Vectorless RAG knowledge assistant (Python)
summary: Cited answers over a document set with no vector database: a heading tree and SQLite FTS5 BM25, refusals, access control in SQL, guardrails against planted instructions, and a gate on 40 golden questions. Web pages come in through an allow-listed crawler. A model is an optional switch.
verified: RUN: the 62 tests (the crawler's against a local web server) and the 40 golden questions ran here on Python 3.13 and 3.11 with the offline stub model: BM25 alone 35 of 40, with synonyms 39 of 40, tree navigation with synonyms 40 of 40, 0 safety violations; the image built and its gate passed 40 of 40 inside the container with no network. NOT RUN: the anthropic provider against the live API (no route to it from here); its request is tested with a fake transport.
stack_line: A vectorless retrieval-augmented assistant in Python 3.11+ (standard library; pypdf for PDF).
run_cmd: uv run -m vrag ask "How many days of annual leave do I get?"
next: Build stage by stage from stories/stories.json, to docs/contracts.md; each stage's tests already exist.
Run /verify-rag before calling a story done.
Replace corpus/ and evals/golden.jsonl with your own documents and questions.

ai_act.purpose: Answers people's questions from the team's documents and cites the sources it used.
notice: Answers are written by AI from your documents. Check the cited source before you act on one.

open_line: No vector database and no embedding service; answers can come from an open-weight model through any OpenAI-compatible server.
cost_line: the system block cached on every model call; outline navigation on its own `navigate_model` (a small model is enough) and answers on `answer_model`; repeat questions answered from a cache kept per reader's access and index version; at most five sections reach the model.
container_check: docker run --rm --network none app:ci uv run -m vrag eval --gate
